title: Fourier Lemmas on the Three-Torus: Heat Smoothing, the $L^2$ Strain Identity,\\ and the Curl of the Energy Derivative, Formalised in Lean~4

claims.statement: If $|m(n)|\le1$ for all $n$, then $T_m f=\sum m(n)\hat f(n)e_n$ defines $T_m:L^2\to L^2$ with $\|T_mf\|_2\le\|f\|_2$.

claims.statement: The same holds for every real $k\ge0$ with $k!$ replaced by $\lceil k\rceil!$.
claims.title: \texttt{heat\_smoothing\_real}

claims.statement: For $k\ne0$, $k\cdot\hat u=0$: $H(\mathrm{curl}\,\hat u)=\tfrac12|\hat u|^2$; $H(\omega+\varepsilon\eta)=H(\omega)+\varepsilon\,\mathrm{Re}\langle\hat\psi,\eta\rangle+\varepsilon^2H(\eta)$, so $\delta H/\delta\omega=\hat\psi$; and $2\pi i\,k\times\hat\psi=\hat u$, i.e.\ $\mathrm{curl}(\delta H/\delta\omega)=u$.
